About The Role
We're looking for a mid-level Product Manager to join us in working directly
with customers to understand their pain points and turning individual asks into solutions that scale across our whole customer base. This role sits across web and mobile, with a strong focus on compliance and platform consistency, and partners closely with Engineering, UX, Solutions Consulting, and Support.
This is a role for someone who is genuinely curious about customers and how the product works in their hands, who can hold their own in a triad, and who's comfortable making prioritization calls backed by evidence rather than instinct alone.
What you'll work on
• Work directly with customers to understand pain points and use cases, with a particular focus on customer-raised asks and requests
• Translate individual customer problems into solutions that can be rolled out to the broader customer base, not just the requesting account
• Understand and solve for compliance requirements across both web and mobile platforms
• Translate web features into mobile features, ensuring parity and platform-appropriate design
• Define and prioritize projects and tasks based on evidence and stakeholder consultation
• Proactively report on progress and challenges to stakeholders and leadership
• Own and drive product briefs, working in close collaboration with Engineering, UX, Solutions Consulting (SC), and Support
• Run gap analyses across multiple areas of the platform to identify where it falls short of customer or compliance needs

Requirements
What you bring
• 3-5 years of experience in Product Management (or equivalent experience translating customer needs into shipped features)
• Genuine curiosity about customers and how they use the product
• Ability to clearly articulate problems, proposed solutions, and recommendations, including the trade-offs behind them
• Strong communication skills, confident and articulate with customers, internal stakeholders, and engineers alike
• Demonstrated experience working within a triad model (Product, Engineering, UX) and directly with customers
• Solid instincts for user experience, knowing what makes a feature usable, not just functional
• Comfort working across both web and mobile product surfaces
Nice to have
• Experience with AI tools applied to product workflows
• Data-driven decision making
• Experience defining and measuring success metrics for shipped features
• Ability to uncover common themes across disparate customer feedback
Why this role matters
This PM sits close to the customer, translating real, individual problems into solutions that hold up across the whole platform and customer base. The work directly shapes how consistent, compliant, and usable the product feels across web and mobile, and gives you real ownership over problems from discovery through to delivery.

Benefits
• Flexibility in work hours and location, with a focus on managing energy rather than time.
• Access to online learning platforms and a budget for professional development
• A collaborative, no-silos environment, encouraging learning and growth across teams
• A dynamic social culture with team lunches, social events, and opportunities for creative input
• Health insurance
• Leave Benefits
• Provident Fund
• Gratuity

If you possess the required skills and are eager to contribute to our team's success, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity. Apply now!

bb840d087a196f11.description: # AI Engineer ### ABOUT TIMEPAY.AI At [timepay.ai](https://timepay.ai/) we are on a mission to revolutionize how enterprises connect with their customers. Traditional approaches to collections, sales, and customer engagement are outdated—impersonal, inflexible, and wasteful of resources. We build and deploy intelligent, human-like AI agents that operate 24/7, using predictive analytics to make communication more efficient, effective, and empathetic. - **What we've built:** - **Vox-v1** - Our flagship TTS engine with 15+ emotions, 12+ languages, and sub-100ms latency - **Voice AI Agents** - Autonomous agents handling millions of inbound & outbound calls. Automated workflow across multiple channels i.e sms, email whatsapp etc. - **Our funds:** We are a funded startup 💰 ### **POSITION OVERVIEW** We are seeking an exceptional AI/NLP Engineer to drive the intelligence behind our AI Agents for the enterprises. You'll work directly with our CTO and AI research team to develop, fine-tune, and deploy state-of-the-art language models that power multilingual, context-aware conversations with millions of customers. This role is for an AI specialist who thrives on pushing the boundaries of what's possible—from fine-tuning large language models for domain-specific tasks and building robust NLP pipelines to creating high-quality datasets and conducting applied research that directly improves our AI agents' performance. If you're passionate about applied AI/NLP, love experimenting with cutting-edge models, and want to build AI systems that directly impact how financial institutions operate, this is the perfect opportunity for you ### **YOUR ROLE** - Design and build high-quality datasets for training and evaluation, including synthetic data generation, data annotation pipelines, and quality assurance - Conduct applied research to improve agent performance in multilingual settings, intent classification, sentiment analysis, and context understanding - Optimize and fine-tune TTS models for naturalness, emotion control, and low-latency performance across multiple languages - Develop and improve ASR/STT systems for accurate transcription in noisy environments, handling code-mixed speech and domain-specific vocabulary - Fine-tune and adapt large language models (LLMs) for industry-specific use cases including collections, customer service, and sales conversations - Develop sophisticated prompt engineering strategies and few-shot learning approaches to optimize model performance - Design comprehensive evaluation frameworks including automated testing, human-in-the-loop evaluation, and A/B testing methodologies - Build and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines for grounding AI responses in regulatory documents and financial knowledge bases - Develop and optimize models for Indian languages (Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali, etc.) with focus on code-mixing and transliteration - Implement model monitoring, drift detection, and continuous improvement pipelines for production AI systems ### **Why This Role Rocks** - Work directly with India’s First Emotive TTS - our proprietary Vox-v1 TTS engine (sub-100ms latency, 15+ emotions) and contribute to next-generation voice AI - Build systems that power AI agents serving India's leading Enterprises. - We offer a competitive salary and meaningful equity options we want you to grow with the company. - Work with a focused team that values clean code, system design excellence, and continuous learning. ### **QUALIFICATIONS** - 3+ years experience in AI/NLP with production deployments - Expert-level experience fine-tuning language models using: - Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA, QLoRA, Adapter layers) - Instruction tuning and RLHF concepts - Domain adaptation techniques - Fine-tuning and optimizing neural TTS models (Tacotron, FastSpeech, VITS, or similar) - Working with ASR architectures (Whisper, Wav2Vec2, Conformer, or similar) - Strong proficiency in PyTorch with hands-on model training experience - Solid understanding of - Transformer architectures (attention mechanisms, positional encoding) - Pre-training and transfer learning strategies - Tokenization, embeddings, and language representation - Proven experience building high-quality training datasets including Synthetic data generation techniques and Data augmentation approaches - Understanding of model serving, API integration, and latency optimization ### **SOUNDS LIKE YOU?** - **User-obsessed:** Users come first, above all else. - **Communication:** You over-communicate. You communicate clearly and precisely, both verbally and in writing, including explaining technical concepts. - **Timeliness:** You respect timelines and communicate beforehand if there is a blocker - **Ownership**: You proactively take initiative to find solutions and focus on what must be done to create success. - **Grit**: You pursue challenging goals with passion and courage. - **Intellectual curiosity:** You want to constantly push yourself out of your comfort zone to try and learn new things - **Entrepreneurial:** You are empowered to take decisions and act on them, treating this startup as your own ## **What We Offer** - **Competitive Package:** Attractive salary and equity options grow with the company - **Technical Impact:** Build systems that power AI agents serving India’s leading financial institutions - **Growth Opportunity:** Join a fast-growing startup where your technical decisions have direct business impact - **Engineering Culture:** Work with a team that values clean code, system design excellence, and continuous learning - **Flexibility:** Hybrid work model with focus on results and technical excellence ## **Ready to Join Us?** If you’re excited about building robust, scalable systems that power the future of enterprises, we’d love to hear from you. Come help us build the infrastructure that will transform enterprises engage with their customers through AI.
